docTitle: The Way — Paul | The Gospel to the Ends of the Earth
metaDesc: From the light on the Damascus road to a rented house in Rome. Walk 42 scenes of Paul's life on a Bible map, and read the letters he wrote in those places.
mapAria: Paul's way on a map of the Mediterranean, from Jerusalem to Rome
introTag: From the Damascus road to Rome, the way the gospel went to the ends of the earth
introLead: Walk the map and follow Paul's travels, and read the letters he wrote in those places.
introF1: Follow the places, from Antioch and Ephesus, Philippi and Corinth, across the sea to Rome
introF3: Hear the story read aloud, and read the letters Paul wrote in those places
landStep2: Read the story and the texts on the card, and press ▶ to hear it read aloud
landStep4: Gather the words of the Lord and of Paul in the '{words}' tab, and revisit the scenes you have walked with '{quiz}'
hisWords: Words of the Lord and of Paul
wordsHead: Words of the Lord and of Paul
wordsIntro: The words the Lord spoke and the words Paul proclaimed along Paul's way, gathered in the order of the journey. Every saying is a fresh rendering of the original meaning in today's language.
odoTitle: Distance walked up to this scene (estimated road and sea distance between places; steps at a 75 cm stride)
endLead: From the Damascus road to a rented house in Rome — thank you for walking with us.
blessing:
I have fought the good fight, I have finished the race, I have kept the faith. (2 Tim 4:7)
May the one who called Paul on the Damascus road call your name too, and walk that way with you to the end, wherever you are.
